items.title: Muir: Linear Attention with Sensitivity-Allocated Gating and Matched-Filter Readout
items.snippet: Linear attention compresses context into a fixed-size key-value state for linear-time training and constant-memory inference. Gated delta-rule models decay this state and erase its prediction for an incoming key before writing a new value; Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) generalizes this with channel-wise decay and decoupled, full-rank erase and write gates. However, we show that state updates are far less sensitive to erasure than to writes: key activation and unit normalization concentrate key energy onto a sparse subset of channels, whereas value writes scale all channels, so the erase gate can be parameterized at lower rank. Furthermore, slow-decaying state rows accumulate much larger norms tha
items.title_ar: Muir: Linear Attention with Sensitivity-Allocated Gating and Matched-Filter Readout
items.summary_ar: يقدّم البحث Muir تحسيناً على linear attention مبنياً على Gated DeltaNet-2، عبر تخصيص gating حسب الحساسية. يوضح الباحثون أن بوابة erase يمكن أن تكون منخفضة الرتبة لأن تحديثات state أقل حساسية للمسح منها للكتابة، كما تتراكم صفوف state الأبطأ في الاضمحلال بنورمات أكبر.
items.why_ar: قد يفيد بحثك في بنى attention بديلة تقلل تكلفة الذاكرة أثناء inference.
items.title_en: Muir: Linear Attention with Sensitivity-Allocated Gating
items.summary_en: The paper proposes Muir, a linear attention method built on GDN-2 that allocates gating by sensitivity. It shows erase gates can be lower-rank because state updates are far less sensitive to erasure than to writes.
items.why_en: It is relevant to research on memory-efficient attention alternatives for long-context inference.

items.title: Reducing Representational Interference in Retrieval Embeddings with Trainable Prefix Tokens
items.snippet: Embedding models compress variable-length text into fixed-size vector representations, but this compression can entangle semantic content with residual token-level information, such as artifacts arising from attention sink behavior. We propose a simple method that prepends trainable [DUMP] tokens to the input during embedding model training. The method keeps the model architecture, pooling strategy, and training loss unchanged, while optimizing the added tokens through the standard contrastive retrieval objective. By introducing trainable prefix positions that interact with regular tokens during encoding, [DUMP] tokens help reduce the influence of residual or uninformative token-level signal
items.title_ar: تدريب embeddings بتوكنات prefix قابلة للتدريب لتقليل التداخل
items.summary_ar: يقترح البحث إضافة توكنات [DUMP] قابلة للتدريب في بداية المدخلات أثناء تدريب embedding model. تبقى البنية وطريقة الـ pooling ودالة الخسارة دون تغيير، وتُحسَّن التوكنات المضافة عبر هدف contrastive retrieval القياسي. الهدف تقليل تأثير الإشارات المتبقية غير المفيدة على التمثيلات الدلالية.
items.why_ar: يفيده في تحسين جودة retrieval داخل أنظمة RAG التي يبني فيها embeddings ويضبطها.
items.title_en: Trainable prefix tokens to reduce embedding interference
items.summary_en: The paper prepends trainable [DUMP] tokens to inputs during embedding model training. The architecture, pooling, and contrastive loss stay unchanged, while the added tokens are optimized through the standard retrieval objective. The goal is to reduce the influence of residual, uninformative token-level signal on the representations.
items.why_en: It can improve retrieval quality in RAG systems where you train or tune embeddings.

items.title: Signed but Steerable: Measuring and Closing the Text-Vector Integrity Gap in Offline Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.snippet: Offline retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on edge devices is updated through signed knowledge packs that carry text and precomputed embedding vectors. A signature proves who published a pack, not that its vectors encode its text. We study this text-vector integrity gap. A verifier that recomputes vectors and accepts them within a cosine tolerance concedes a predictable share of queries to an attacker who controls the vectors: the hijack rate equals the distribution of angular retrieval margins at the tolerance (the margin law). Margins are small in five corpora and two embedding models, so an idealised tolerance at the level of floating-point noise leaves up to 5.5% of queries exposed (at
items.title_ar: Signed but Steerable: فجوة سلامة النص والمتجهات في RAG دون اتصال
items.summary_ar: تدرس الورقة RAG على الأجهزة الطرفية عبر knowledge packs موقعة تحمل النص وvectors محسوبة مسبقاً. التوقيع يثبت الناشر فقط ولا يضمن أن الـ vectors تمثل النص، مما يسمح لمهاجم يتحكم بالمتجهات بالتأثير على نسبة من الاستعلامات. تقيس الدراسة هذه الفجوة عبر خمسة corpora ونموذجي embedding، وتعالج إغلاقها.
items.why_ar: يهمه إذا كان ينشر أو يستقبل knowledge packs لأنظمة RAG في بيئات حساسة.
items.title_en: Signed but Steerable: text-vector integrity gap in offline RAG
items.summary_en: The paper studies offline RAG on edge devices that use signed knowledge packs containing text and precomputed vectors. A signature proves the publisher but not that the vectors match the text, so an attacker controlling vectors can hijack a share of queries. The authors measure this gap across five corpora and two embedding models and address how to close it.
items.why_en: It matters if you ship or verify knowledge packs for RAG in sensitive or offline environments.

items.title: Tools Need Not Speak in Text: Latent Context Compression for Agents
items.snippet: Large language model (LLM) agents typically append raw tool outputs to their context. Over multi-step interactions, long and noisy observations incur substantial context overhead and dilute the agent's attention to task-relevant information. Existing token pruning and summarization methods remain constrained by discrete text representations, limiting the achievable compression ratios. In this work, we challenge the prevailing assumption that agents must consume tool observations as explicit text tokens. To this end, we propose Coca-Cola, a continuous latent context compression model for LLM agents. Coca-Cola compresses tool observations into latent tokens and embeds them into the input embed
items.title_ar: Coca-Cola: ضغط سياق latent لمخرجات أدوات الـ agents
items.summary_ar: يقترح الباحثون نموذج Coca-Cola لضغط مخرجات الأدوات إلى latent tokens ثم تضمينها في input embeddings الخاصة بالـ LLM agent. الفكرة أن الأدوات لا تحتاج أن تُستهلك كنص صريح، وهذا يقلل context overhead ويحسن تركيز الـ agent. تتجاوز الطريقة حدود الضغط المعتمد على تقليم التوكنات والتلخيص النصي.
items.why_ar: يهمه إذا كانت أدوات الـ agents في مشاريعه تستهلك سياقاً طويلاً ومكلفاً.
items.title_en: Coca-Cola: latent context compression for agent tool outputs
items.summary_en: The paper proposes Coca-Cola, a model that compresses tool observations into latent tokens and embeds them into the agent's input. It argues agents need not consume tool outputs as explicit text tokens. This reduces context overhead beyond what token pruning and text summarization can achieve.
items.why_en: It is relevant if your agents suffer from long, noisy tool outputs that inflate context cost.

items.title: Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench: The First Agentic and Verifiable Benchmark for Mathematical Modeling
items.snippet: Mathematical modeling turns an open-ended real-world problem into assumptions, a model, a solution, and a defended recommendation, and its answers matter only if they are both close to a credible reference and physically feasible; existing benchmarks either score solver fragments or grade reports with an LLM judge, leaving those numbers unchecked. We introduce TB-MathModel (the Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench), the first benchmark to make complete contest-style modeling problems agentic, verifiable, and terminal at once, over 18 real CUMCM and MCM problems (2023--2025). Each task ships the verbatim statement, official attachments, and figures in a containerized terminal; the agent
items.title_ar: TB-MathModel: First Agentic Verifiable Benchmark for Mathematical Modeling
items.summary_ar: يقدم TB-MathModel أول benchmark يجمع طابع agent القابل للتحقق مع تشغيله داخل terminal لمسائل النمذجة الرياضية. تتكون المجموعة من 18 مسألة من CUMCM وMCM للأعوام 2023 إلى 2025، وكل مهمة تعمل داخل container مع ملفاتها الرسمية.
items.why_ar: يفيدك في تقييم agents على مهام تحليلية معقدة تحتاج تحققاً آلياً.
items.title_en: TB-MathModel: First Agentic Verifiable Benchmark for Mathematical Modeling
items.summary_en: TB-MathModel introduces a benchmark of 18 real CUMCM and MCM modeling problems from 2023 to 2025. Each task runs in a containerized terminal with official attachments, and answers are verified rather than judged by an LLM.
items.why_en: It offers a verifiable way to evaluate agents on complex analytical tasks.

items.title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
items.snippet: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. However, the process is often slow because the LLM generates a long textual chain of thought for each round and must repeat this generation many times to maintain population diversity. We present SwarmEvolve, a framework in which hundreds of low-cost agents per round work in swarms, reason in latent space without decoding to text, and share information by passing KV caches. Each swarm studies the problem from a different angle. A novelty filter keeps the most distinct agent ideas by directly measuring the distances
items.title_ar: SwarmEvolve: أسراب agents كامنة لاكتشاف الحلول التطورية
items.summary_ar: يقدم الإطار SwarmEvolve مئات agents منخفضة التكلفة في كل جولة، تعمل ككتل وتستدل في latent space دون فك التشفير إلى نص، وتتبادل المعلومات عبر KV caches. يستخدم novelty filter لاختيار الأفكار الأكثر تمايزاً عبر قياس المسافات بينها. الهدف تسريع البحث التطوري المعتمد على LLM في المسائل الرياضية والحسابية.
items.why_ar: يهمه إذا كان يبني أنظمة agents لتحسين الخوارزميات أو البحث عن حلول تقنية.
items.title_en: SwarmEvolve: latent agent swarms for evolutionary search
items.summary_en: SwarmEvolve runs hundreds of low-cost agents per round as swarms that reason in latent space and share information through KV caches. A novelty filter keeps the most distinct ideas by measuring distances between them. The aim is to speed up LLM-guided evolutionary search for mathematical and computational problems.
items.why_en: It matters if you build agent systems for program or solution search and want faster iteration.

items.title: StepX-OPD: Rethinking Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation in Diffusion Models
items.snippet: A deployable text-to-image diffusion model must hold several capabilities at once, such as instruction following, text rendering and human preference, and must sample in a few steps. Capabilities and few-step sampling are built in separate stages: a full-step model first consolidates capabilities through multi-teacher on-policy distillation, then serves as a fixed teacher for step distillation. Every full-step model we evaluate scores lower once compressed, and the second stage cannot begin until the first finishes. We introduce StepX-OPD, which merges the two stages: one student acquires every capability while learning to sample in a few steps, so frozen specialists supervise it on the stat
items.title_ar: StepX-OPD يدمج multi-teacher distillation وfew-step sampling في موديلات diffusion
items.summary_ar: تقترح الورقة StepX-OPD، وهي طريقة تدمج مرحلتين منفصلتين في تدريب موديلات text-to-image: اكتساب عدة قدرات معاً مثل instruction following وtext rendering وhuman preference، إلى جانب أخذ العينات في عدد قليل من الخطوات. بدلاً من تسلسل المرحلتين، يتعلم الطالب الاثنين معاً بإشراف متخصصين مجمدين. يذكر الباحثون أن كل موديل كامل الخطوات قيّموه فقد جودة بعد الضغط.
items.why_ar: إن نشر فريقك توليد الصور داخلياً يوماً ما، فهذه الورقة توضح كيف تحافظ على الجودة مع تقليل الـ inference steps والتكلفة.
items.title_en: StepX-OPD merges multi-teacher distillation and few-step sampling in diffusion models
items.summary_en: The paper proposes StepX-OPD, which merges two stages of training a text-to-image diffusion model: acquiring multiple capabilities such as instruction following, text rendering and human preference, and learning few-step sampling. Instead of a sequential pipeline, one student learns both at once while frozen specialist teachers supervise it. The authors note that every full-step model they evaluated lost quality once compressed.
items.why_en: If your team deploys image generation internally, this shows how to keep quality while cutting inference steps and cost.

items.title: Information Games: Strategic Crowding and Firm Repositioning in Language-Model Space

In competitive markets, these investment decisions publicized in news articles and analyst reports, measuring the changes in capital structure, product mix, firm leadership, risk exposure and operating procedure made by the firm. Modern search engines rely on Large Language Models to measure the relevancy of source documents to given search query. items.summary_ar: تمثل الورقة مقالات الأخبار والتقارير كسحب من dense vectors باستخدام LLM، بحيث تعكس هندستها اختلاف الشركات عبر الزمن. تربط الدراسة قرارات الاستثمار والقدرات بالتنافس على التدفقات النقدية المستقبلية. تعتمد المنهجية على تقييم صلة الوثائق بالاستعلامات كما تفعل محركات البحث الحديثة.
